products.name: Mahalaxmi Chevdo
products.description: Mahalaxmi Chevdo is our signature festive mixture — crisp basmati rice flakes tossed with roasted peanuts, crunchy gram-flour sev, curry leaves and a whisper of green chilli, all fried in pure groundnut oil. Every small batch is made with sendha namak and real hing, keeping strictly to 100% Jain principles — zero onion, zero garlic, zero preservatives. The crunch is packed fresh, so every handful tastes like it just left the halwai's kadhai.
products.shortDescription: Signature Jain chevdo — crispy rice flakes, sev & peanuts in pure groundnut oil.
products.ingredients: Basmati rice flakes, roasted peanuts, gram flour (besan) sev, groundnut oil, curry leaves, green chilli, sendha namak (rock salt), asafoetida (hing), turmeric, mustard seeds
products.storageInstructions: Store in an airtight container away from direct sunlight and moisture. Best enjoyed fresh; shake well before serving.
products.metaDescription: Buy Mahalaxmi Chevdo — 100% Jain, onion-free, garlic-free festive namkeen made with pure groundnut oil. Crispy, authentic and packed fresh.

products.name: Mari Basmati Chevdo
products.description: Mari Basmati Chevdo pairs light, airy puffed rice (mari) with crisp basmati flakes, roasted peanuts and fine gram-flour sev. Fried in pure groundnut oil and seasoned with sendha namak, hing and a gentle spice blend, it is lighter on the crunch and heavier on the aroma than a classic chevdo. Made in small Jain batches — zero onion, zero garlic, zero preservatives.

products.name: Ghav Chevdo
products.description: Ghav Chevdo is built around ghav — delicate, paper-thin rice wafers — tossed with roasted peanuts, gram-flour sev and fragrant curry leaves. The wafers shatter with a satisfying crunch while the spice blend stays gentle and warm. Fried in pure groundnut oil and seasoned with sendha namak and hing, it follows our strict 100% Jain recipe: no onion, no garlic, no preservatives.

products.name: Methi Gathiya
products.description: Methi Gathiya folds fresh fenugreek (methi) leaves into a gram-flour dough that is hand-pressed into thick, ridged strands and fried golden in pure groundnut oil. The methi lends a gentle herbal bitterness that balances the savoury besan — a Gujarati classic done right. Made with sendha namak and real hing, strictly Jain: zero onion, zero garlic, zero preservatives.
